brief:
Israeli occupation forces delivered more than 20 demolition notices Monday targeting agricultural and commercial structures in Jenin governorate, northern occupied West Bank, according to Shehab Wire. The notices coincided with Israeli forces expelling farmers from their land in the village of Arqah, west of the governorate, and preventing them from harvesting olives.

The demolition orders and expulsions marked an escalation of enforcement actions in the district, affecting both infrastructure and livelihoods during the olive harvest season.

title: Israel issues demolition orders for 20+ facilities in Jenin
